question: ¿Cuántos cambios de operadora hubo en las concesiones entre 2023 y 2025, si cada mes la operadora de una concesión es la empresa que declara la mayor parte de su producción (petróleo en m³ más gas en miles de m³), solo cuentan las rachas de al menos 3 meses seguidos con la misma operadora, y hay un cambio cada vez que la racha siguiente es de otra empresa? Contar como una sola empresa a Pluspetrol S.A. y Pluspetrol Cuenca Neuquina S.R.L., a CGC Energía SAU y Compañía General de Combustibles S.A., y a GeoPark Argentina Ltd. (Sucursal Argentina) y GeoPark Argentina S.A.

attempts.query: WITH base AS (SELECT anio, mes, idareapermisoconcesion AS conc, empresa, prod_pet, prod_gas FROM capitulo4.produccion_historica WHERE anio BETWEEN 2023 AND 2024 UNION ALL SELECT anio, mes, idareapermisoconcesion, empresa, prod_pet, prod_gas FROM capitulo4.produccion WHERE anio = 2025), norm AS (SELECT anio, mes, conc, CASE WHEN upper(empresa) LIKE '%PLUSPETROL%' THEN 'PLUSPETROL' WHEN upper(empresa) LIKE '%GENERAL DE COMBUSTIBLES%' OR upper(trim(empresa)) LIKE 'CGC%' THEN 'CGC' WHEN upper(empresa) LIKE '%GEOPARK%' THEN 'GEOPARK' ELSE upper(trim(empresa)) END AS emp, COALESCE(prod_pet,0) + COALESCE(prod_gas,0) AS vol FROM base WHERE conc IS NOT NULL AND empresa IS NOT NULL), por_emp AS (SELECT conc, anio*12 + mes AS idx, emp, SUM(vol) AS vol FROM norm GROUP BY conc, anio*12 + mes, emp), ranked AS (SELECT conc, idx, emp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conc, idx ORDER BY vol DESC, emp) AS rn FROM por_emp), op AS (SELECT conc, idx, emp FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), islas AS (SELECT conc, emp, idx, idx - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY conc, emp ORDER BY idx) AS grp FROM op), rachas AS (SELECT conc, emp, MIN(idx) AS inicio, COUNT(*) AS largo FROM islas GROUP BY conc, emp, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), seq AS (SELECT conc, emp, LAG(emp) OVER (PARTITION BY conc ORDER BY inicio) AS prev FROM rachas) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cambios FROM seq WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND prev <> emp
